notes.title: Live updates are connected
notes.body: Ultimate Trainer now checks its hosted release feed automatically. No hosting setup or update address is needed.

notes.title: Install when you are ready
notes.body: Review the changelog, approve the update, and the trainer downloads, verifies, installs and restarts in place.

notes.title: Your cockpit stays yours
notes.body: Your themes, sounds and preferences carry over. The animated changelog shows what changed after the update.

notes.title: Older blank settings repaired
notes.body: Previously empty update settings now adopt the built-in live feed. Custom update addresses remain saved.
